parameters.connection: single prewarmed SSH ControlMaster shared by all tools; probe SSH uses separate connection
parameters.wire_counter: encrypted SSH stream bytes through common loopback TCP relay; excludes TCP/IP headers; master setup and verification/probes excluded
parameters.memory: sampled sum of sender process group RSS; excludes pre-existing shared SSH master; 100ms polling plus ps/probe overhead
parameters.cache: warm/shared source, no privileged cache eviction, balanced Latin rotation, fresh receiver directories
parameters.contract: content and relative paths only; same independent external SHA-256 after every successful command; tool built-in hashing remains enabled
parameters.durability: process-completion and content verification, no common fsync/power-loss contract
parameters.cut_basis: sender encrypted SSH stream budget; same counting-proxy callback for all tools

excluded_diagnostics.reason: probe latency caused unequal cut points; all nine excluded regardless of speed; original records retained locally
